name: @activepieces/piece-simplyprint
description: 3D printer fleet management: monitor printers, manage the print queue, track filament, and automate print jobs.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

list_printers.name: list_printers
list_printers.description: List every printer in your SimplyPrint account with current status.

page.description: Specific page number (1-based). Leave empty to walk all pages and return every printer.

pageSize.description: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 100 when paging is requested.

aiMetadata.description: Read-only listing of printers in the account with current status. By default it walks all pages and returns every printer; pass a page number to fetch just that single page instead. Pick this to discover printer IDs and live state (e.g. to find idle printers before starting a job); it never modifies anything.

get_farm_overview.name: get_farm_overview
get_farm_overview.description: One-shot fleet summary: total printer count plus per-bucket lists (online/offline, printing/paused, awaiting bed clear, in maintenance, requires-attention, AI failure detections, …). Use this instead of paginating "List Printers" when you just need counts and the printers in each state.

aiMetadata.description: Returns a single fleet-wide snapshot: total printer count plus per-state buckets (online/offline, printing/paused, awaiting bed clear, in maintenance, requires-attention, AI failure detections, etc.) each listing the printers in it. Prefer this over paginating "List Printers" when you only need counts or which printers are in a given state. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

get_printer.name: get_printer
get_printer.description: Get detailed information about a specific printer.

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full record for a single printer by its numeric printer ID (state, settings, current job, etc.). Use to inspect or look up one known printer before acting on it; for a fleet-wide snapshot or counts use "Get Farm Overview" or "List Printers" instead. Read-only and idempotent.

pause_print.name: pause_print
pause_print.description: Pause the current print on a printer.

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

resume_print.name: resume_print
resume_print.description: Resume a paused print on a printer.

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

cancel_print.name: cancel_print
cancel_print.description: Cancel the current print on a printer. This is destructive — the job cannot be resumed.

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

cancel_pending_print.name: cancel_pending_print
cancel_pending_print.description: Cancel a print that's queued/staged on a printer but hasn't started yet (status = print_pending). Distinct from "Cancel Print", which targets the active print.

printerIds.description: Numeric printer IDs whose pending prints should be cancelled.

aiMetadata.description: Cancels prints that are staged/queued on one or more printers but have not started yet (status print_pending), given numeric printer IDs. Pick this for not-yet-running prints; use the separate "Cancel Print" action for the currently active print. Idempotent: once a printer has no pending print the call converges to the same state.

clear_printer_bed.name: clear_printer_bed
clear_printer_bed.description: Mark a printer's bed as cleared after a print finishes. Bread-and-butter step in AutoPrint flows — pair with a "print done" trigger to automate bed clearing.

success.description: Was the bed actually cleared (true) or did it fail (false)? Drives AutoPrint clear-count logic.

rating.description: Optional 1-4 star rating for the just-finished print.

autoPrintResetClearCount.description: When checked, resets the AutoPrint cleared-bed counter on the printer.

aiMetadata.description: Mark the bed of one or more printers as cleared after a finished print, optionally recording success/failure, a 1-4 star print rating, and an AutoPrint clear-count reset. Pick it as the post-print confirmation step in AutoPrint flows so the next queued job can start. Not idempotent — each call records a clear event and advances AutoPrint state.

skip_print_objects.name: skip_print_objects
skip_print_objects.description: Skip one or more individual model objects on the current print (printer must be in PRINTING / PAUSED / PAUSING / CANCELLING / RESUMING state). Single printer per call.

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID of the active print.

objectIds.description: Numeric indices of the objects to skip (as exposed by the slicer / printer's object list).

aiMetadata.description: Skips individual model objects on the print currently running on one printer, by their slicer/printer object indices. Use mid-print to abandon failed or unwanted objects while letting the rest finish; the target printer must be actively PRINTING/PAUSED/PAUSING/CANCELLING/RESUMING and only one printer is allowed per call. Not idempotent: each call instructs the firmware to abandon more objects on the live print.

set_printer_out_of_order.name: set_printer_out_of_order
set_printer_out_of_order.description: Mark one or more printers as out-of-order (or clear that flag). Requires the Out-of-Order feature on the account.

outOfOrder.description: True = mark as out-of-order. False = clear the flag.

aiMetadata.description: Sets or clears the out-of-order flag on one or more printers by numeric ID; a boolean toggles between marking them out-of-order and clearing it. Use to take printers in/out of service in the fleet. Requires the Out-of-Order feature enabled on the account. Idempotent: it sets a flag to a fixed value rather than accumulating changes.

send_gcode.name: send_gcode
send_gcode.description: Send raw G-code commands to an operational printer (requires Print Farm plan).

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

gcode.description: One G-code command per line, e.g. "G28" then "M104 S200". Up to 200 lines per request.

aiMetadata.description: Send raw G-code commands (one per line, up to 200 lines) to an operational printer by ID. Pick this for low-level printer control — homing, temperature, movement, custom macros — when no higher-level action exists. Not idempotent: commands execute on the physical printer each time, so re-running repeats the motion/heating. Requires the Print Farm plan.

start_print.name: start_print
start_print.description: Start a print job on one or more printers from an existing file, queue item, or print-job reference.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

printerIds.description: Pick one or more printers from your account.

fileSource.description: Which kind of existing reference to start from.

options.label: API file (hash from Upload File action)

apiFileId.description: Required when source is "API file". Hex hash returned by Upload File.

userFileUid.description: Required when source is "User file". The UserFile.uid string.

sharedCustomFields.description: Custom-field values applied to every started job (PRINT_JOB). Keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value.

individualCustomFields.description: Optional. JSON array `[{"id": <queueItemId>, "value": {"<fieldId>": <value>}}]`. Per-item PRINT_JOB custom fields when starting a multi-queue job.

startOptions.description: Optional slicer/print-time metadata (nozzle, filament_material, print_speed, layer_height, infill, quality). Arbitrary keys allowed.

mmsMap.description: Optional. JSON object mapping printer id → multi-material slot configuration. Leave empty for single-material printers.

aiMetadata.description: Start a print job on one or more selected printers from an existing reference — choose the file source mode: an uploaded API file (hash), an existing user file (UID), or a pending queue item ID. Pick this to physically begin printing; it is the main "go" action and supports per-job custom fields, start options, and multi-material slot maps. Not idempotent — each call launches new jobs, so re-running starts additional prints.

get_printer_notifications.name: get_printer_notifications
get_printer_notifications.description: Fetch the open notifications/events on one or more printers. Pairs well with the `requires_attention` bucket from "Get Farm Overview".

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the open notifications/events for one or more printers by their numeric IDs. Read-only; pick it to discover notification IDs (and which need attention) before calling the resolve-notification tool. Idempotent.

resolve_printer_notification.name: resolve_printer_notification
resolve_printer_notification.description: Mark a printer notification as resolved (or dismissed). For notifications with multiple actions, pass `action` to pick one or `force: true` to resolve without choosing.

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID the notification belongs to.

notificationId.description: Numeric notification event ID. Use "Get Printer Notifications" to look it up.

action.description: For multi-action notifications, the action key to invoke. Leave empty for single-action or dismiss-only notifications.

force.description: Resolve immediately even if multiple actions are available (skips picking one).

dismiss.description: Mark as dismissed rather than resolved.

aiMetadata.description: Resolve or dismiss one printer notification by its event ID. For multi-action notifications, pick a specific action key, or force-resolve to clear it without choosing; set dismiss to mark it dismissed instead of resolved. Idempotent: resolving an already-handled notification has no further effect.

list_queue.name: list_queue
list_queue.description: List items in the print queue, optionally filtered to a single queue group.

groupId.description: Numeric queue group ID to filter by. Leave empty for the whole queue.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Only applies to the active-queue path; ignored when "Include completed items" is on.

aiMetadata.description: Read-only, paginated listing of items in the active print queue, optionally filtered to a single queue group ID. Enable "Include completed items" to also return done items (this switches to the legacy path and ignores paging). Pick this for the main print queue; use List Pending Queue Items for the approval workflow instead. Never modifies anything.

get_queue_item.name: get_queue_item
get_queue_item.description: Fetch a single queue item by numeric ID — returns the formatted record (file metadata, assignments, custom fields, …).

queueItemId.description: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single print-queue item by its numeric ID. Read-only; pick it to inspect one known item (file, assignments, custom fields) rather than to browse or schedule the queue. Idempotent.

get_next_queue_items.name: get_next_queue_items
get_next_queue_items.description: Resolve the next-up queue items for one or more printers using the company's match criteria (with deduplication so the same item is never assigned twice). Returns the matched queue object with item references per printer.

deselectPrinterIds.description: Optional. Printer IDs to skip when matching (e.g. printers currently busy).

aiMetadata.description: Resolve which queue items should print next on the given printer IDs using the account's match criteria, with built-in deduplication so the same item is not handed to two printers. Pick this to drive automatic dispatch of pending work to free printers; optionally exclude busy printer IDs from matching. It is a lookup (no items are started), but match results can shift between calls as the queue changes.

get_next_queue_items_for_printers.name: get_next_queue_items_for_printers
get_next_queue_items_for_printers.displayName: Preview Next Queue Items per Printer
get_next_queue_items_for_printers.description: Read-only preview of the next-up queue item for each given printer (no dedup, no offline checks). For each printer, returns either the matched queue item or the issues blocking a match. Different from "Get Next Queue Items": that one dedupes for actual scheduling, this one shows what each printer would pick.

aiMetadata.description: Preview, per printer, which queue item each would pick next — with no deduplication or offline checks — returning the matched item or the issues blocking a match. Read-only and does not reserve anything; pick the separate dedup-aware scheduling tool ("Get Next Queue Items") when actually assigning work. Idempotent.

list_queue_groups.name: list_queue_groups
list_queue_groups.description: List every queue group on your account.

aiMetadata.description: Read-only listing of every queue group on the account. Pick this to discover available queue groups and their IDs (e.g. to feed a group ID into List Queue Items or Save Queue Group); it takes no inputs and never modifies anything.

save_queue_group.name: save_queue_group
save_queue_group.description: Create or update a queue group. Pass an existing group ID to edit it; omit it to create a new one. Requires the Queue Groups feature on the account.

groupId.description: Numeric ID of the group to edit. Omit to create a new group.

name.description: Display name for the group (max 64 chars).

acceptedExtensions.description: File extensions allowed in this group (without the dot, e.g. `gcode`, `bgcode`). Leave empty for "any".

virtualOnly.description: When true, no real queue items can be added — used for placeholder/grouping-only groups.

forPrinters.description: Optional. Restrict this group to specific printers.

forModels.description: Optional. Restrict this group to specific printer models.

forGroups.description: Optional. Restrict this group to specific printer groups.

visibilityUserRanks.description: Optional. Limit who can see the group based on user rank IDs.

approvalRequiredRanks.description: Optional. User ranks whose submissions need approval.

approvalExemptRanks.description: Optional. User ranks whose submissions skip approval.

requiresApproval.description: Master toggle for approval workflow on this group.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new queue group or update an existing one (pass a group ID to edit, omit it to create), configuring its name, accepted file extensions, printer/model/group restrictions, visibility, and approval rules. When editing by ID it overwrites the group with the supplied settings, so re-running with the same ID is idempotent; omitting the ID always creates a new group. Requires the Queue Groups account feature.

delete_queue_group.name: delete_queue_group
delete_queue_group.description: Delete a queue group. Items in the group are moved to "Move to" group, or to the first remaining group if not specified, or set to ungrouped if it was the last group.

groupId.description: Numeric ID of the queue group to delete.

moveTo.description: Optional target group ID for orphaned items. If omitted, items go to the first remaining group (or become ungrouped if this is the last).

aiMetadata.description: Deletes a queue group by its numeric ID and re-homes its items: to an optional "move to" target group if given, otherwise the first remaining group, or ungrouped if it was the last group. Use to remove a grouping while keeping its queue items. Idempotent in effect: the end state is the same once the group no longer exists.

add_to_queue.name: add_to_queue
add_to_queue.description: Add an existing file (API-uploaded or user-file) to the print queue. For uploading a new file at the same time, use "Upload File & Add to Queue".

options.label: API file (hex id from Upload File action)

apiFileId.description: Hex id returned by Upload File. Required when source is "API file".

userFileUid.description: UID of an existing user-file (from "List Files"). Required when source is "User file". Accepts only the single file UID string.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

groupId.description: Which queue group to add the item to. Required if your account has queue groups configured. Leave empty only if no queue groups exist.

amount.description: Number of copies to queue (defaults to 1).

position.description: Where in the queue to place the new item.

positionNumber.description: Only used when "Insert at" is "Specific position". 1-based index (1 = very top). Requires queue-reorder permission.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

forPrinters.description: Restrict this queue item to one or more specific printers. Leave empty to allow any eligible printer.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

forModels.description: Restrict to printers of specific models. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable). Built from the models your printers are using.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

customTags.description: Custom tags to apply. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable).

nozzleSize.description: Target nozzle diameter, e.g. `0.4`. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

nozzleType.description: Nozzle material. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

nozzleVolumeType.description: Nozzle flow category. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

bedType.description: Printer bed surface. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

customFields.description: Optional. Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. PRINT_QUEUE category is auto-applied.

aiMetadata.description: Queue an already-uploaded file for printing — choose the source (an API file hex ID from an upload step, or an existing user-file UID) plus quantity, target group, printers/models, tags, and custom fields. Use this when the file already exists on SimplyPrint; to upload and queue together use the upload-and-queue tool. Not idempotent — each call adds a new queue item.

update_queue_item.name: update_queue_item
update_queue_item.description: Update a queue item (amount, note, etc.).

queueItemId.description: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

aiMetadata.description: Updates editable fields (quantity, note) on an existing queue item identified by its numeric ID. Use to adjust a known queue entry in place; only the fields you pass are changed. Idempotent: applying the same values keyed to the same item ID converges to the same state.

set_queue_item_printers.name: set_queue_item_printers
set_queue_item_printers.description: Assign one or more queue items to specific printers, printer models, and/or printer groups. Replaces the current assignments on each item.

queueItemIds.description: Numeric queue item IDs to update.

printerIds.description: Numeric printer IDs to assign to. Leave empty to clear printer assignments.

modelIds.description: Numeric printer model IDs. Leave empty to clear model assignments.

groupIds.description: Numeric printer group IDs. Leave empty to clear group assignments.

aiMetadata.description: Sets which printers, printer models, and/or printer groups each given queue item may be assigned to, fully replacing the item's current assignments. Pass empty arrays for a dimension to clear that set of assignments. Requires numeric queue-item IDs; idempotent because it overwrites assignments to a fixed target state rather than appending.

move_queue_item.name: move_queue_item
move_queue_item.description: Move a queue item to a different queue group.

queueItemId.description: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

targetGroupId.description: Numeric ID of the destination queue group.

aiMetadata.description: Reassign one existing print-queue item to a different queue group by its numeric ID. Pick it to reorganize the queue across groups rather than to add or remove items. Idempotent: moving an item already in the target group leaves it there.

remove_from_queue.name: remove_from_queue
remove_from_queue.description: Remove an item from the print queue. Destructive — the item is gone.

queueItemId.description: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a single item from the print queue by its numeric ID. This is destructive — the item is gone (use Archive Print Jobs for completed jobs you only want out of the active view). Deleting an already-removed item simply finds nothing to delete, so the end state is idempotent.

revive_queue_item.name: revive_queue_item
revive_queue_item.description: Bring a completed (done) queue item back to the active queue.

queueItemId.description: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.

aiMetadata.description: Move a previously-completed queue item back into the active print queue by its numeric ID. Pick this to re-print or re-process a job that was already marked done; it changes queue state, so re-running it after the item is already active has no further effect.

empty_queue.name: empty_queue
empty_queue.description: Delete every item from the print queue (optionally filtered to a group or done-only). Destructive.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

groupId.description: Which queue group to add the item to. Required if your account has queue groups configured. Leave empty only if no queue groups exist.

doneOnly.description: When checked, only done items are removed. Pending / printing / failed items stay.

aiMetadata.description: Bulk-delete print-queue items, optionally scoped to a single queue group and/or restricted to only completed items. Destructive and irreversible — prefer the single-item delete/move tools unless a full clear is intended. Idempotent in effect: re-running on an already-empty queue is a no-op.

list_pending_queue_items.name: list_pending_queue_items
list_pending_queue_items.description: List queue items awaiting approval, denied, or sent back for revision.

status.description: Restrict to a single approval status. Defaults to all (pending + denied + revision).

perPage.description: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 50 (backend default).

aiMetadata.description: Read-only, paginated listing of queue items in the approval workflow — pending, denied, or sent back for revision. Pick this to review submissions needing a moderation decision; filter to a single approval status or list all three. Use the general queue listing instead for items already in the active print queue.

approve_queue_item.name: approve_queue_item
approve_queue_item.description: Approve one or more pending queue items.

queueItemIds.description: Numeric IDs of pending queue items to approve.

aiMetadata.description: Approve one or more pending print-queue items by their numeric IDs, with an optional comment, so they can proceed to printing. Pick it to clear an approval gate on queued jobs. Idempotent: approving an already-approved item leaves it approved.

deny_queue_item.name: deny_queue_item
deny_queue_item.description: Deny a pending queue item (remove or send back for revision).

comment.description: Explain why the item is being denied. Shown to the submitter.

requestRevision.description: When checked, the submitter can edit and resubmit. Otherwise the item is removed.

aiMetadata.description: Denies a pending queue item awaiting approval, attaching a required comment shown to the submitter. A "request revision" toggle picks the mode: when set, the item stays as DENIED so the submitter can edit and resubmit; otherwise the item is removed. Use to reject a submission rather than approve it. Idempotent: it drives the item to a fixed denied/removed state.

list_files.name: list_files
list_files.description: List files in your SimplyPrint account, optionally within a folder and/or filtered by a search term.

folderId.description: Leave empty (or 0) to list root-level files. Use -1 for the "all files" flat view.

globalSearch.description: When a search term is provided, search across every folder instead of just the current one.

aiMetadata.description: Browse the SimplyPrint file system, optionally scoped to a folder ID and/or filtered by a filename search term (with an option to search across all folders). Read-only; pick it to discover user-file UIDs and folder IDs needed by upload-to-folder or add-to-queue. Idempotent.

upload_file.name: upload_file
upload_file.description: Upload a file or HTTPS URL to SimplyPrint. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically. Returns the API file id — pass it to "Add File to Queue" or "Start Print" later.

file.description: File data (G-code, STL, 3MF). Used if "File URL" is empty. AP materializes the whole file into RAM before this action runs — for very large files prefer the File URL input below.

fileUrl.description: Alternative to File — an HTTPS URL the piece will stream directly to SimplyPrint without buffering the whole file in memory. Recommended for files over ~500 MB. The URL must return a Content-Length header (S3 pre-signed URLs, Dropbox raw links, signed Google Drive download URLs, etc.). If set, the File input is ignored.

filename.description: Name to store the file under on SimplyPrint. MUST include the correct extension (e.g. .gcode, .stl, .3mf) — the backend picks the file type from the extension, not the contents. Required when using File URL unless the URL path ends in a filename with an extension. Optional with File (defaults to source filename).

aiMetadata.description: Upload a print file (G-code, STL, 3MF) to SimplyPrint, supplied either as a File input or as an HTTPS URL to stream from; the filename extension must be correct since the backend infers type from it. Use this when you only need the file staged for later; to queue or print in one step use the dedicated upload-and-queue or upload-to-folder tools. Not idempotent — each call creates a new uploaded file.

upload_and_queue.name: upload_and_queue
upload_and_queue.description: Upload a local file or HTTPS URL to SimplyPrint and add it to the print queue in one step. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically. For starting the print afterwards, chain a "Start Print" action.

file.description: File data (G-code, STL, 3MF). Used if "File URL" is empty. AP materializes the whole file into RAM before this action runs — for very large files prefer the File URL input below.

fileUrl.description: Alternative to File — an HTTPS URL the piece will stream directly to SimplyPrint without buffering the whole file in memory. Recommended for files over ~500 MB. The URL must return a Content-Length header (S3 pre-signed URLs, Dropbox raw links, etc.). If set, the File input is ignored.

filename.description: Name to store the file under on SimplyPrint. MUST include the correct extension (e.g. .gcode, .stl, .3mf) — the backend picks the file type from the extension, not the contents. Required when using File URL unless the URL path ends in a filename with an extension. Optional with File (defaults to source filename).

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

groupId.description: Which queue group to add the item to. Required if your account has queue groups configured. Leave empty only if no queue groups exist.

amount.description: Number of copies to queue (defaults to 1).

position.description: Where in the queue to place the new item.

positionNumber.description: Only used when "Insert at" is "Specific position". 1-based index (1 = very top). Requires queue-reorder permission.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

forPrinters.description: Restrict this queue item to one or more specific printers. Leave empty to allow any eligible printer.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

forModels.description: Restrict to printers of specific models. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable). Built from the models your printers are using.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

customTags.description: Custom tags to apply. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable).

nozzleSize.description: Target nozzle diameter, e.g. `0.4`. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

nozzleType.description: Nozzle material. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

nozzleVolumeType.description: Nozzle flow category. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

auth.description: Click **Connect** below to authorize Activepieces to access your SimplyPrint account. The connection refreshes automatically. Revoke any time from **SimplyPrint → Panel → Settings → Connected apps**.

bedType.description: Printer bed surface. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.

customFields.description: Optional. Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. PRINT_QUEUE category is auto-applied.

aiMetadata.description: Upload a print file (File input or HTTPS URL) and add it to the print queue in a single step, with quantity, group, target printers/models, tags, and custom fields; returns the new file ID and queue item ID. Pick this when the file is not yet on SimplyPrint; use add-to-queue if it already exists, and chain a start-print action to begin printing. Not idempotent — each call uploads and queues anew.

upload_to_folder.name: upload_to_folder
upload_to_folder.description: Upload a file (or HTTPS URL) and save it to your SimplyPrint user file system, optionally inside a specific folder. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically.

file.description: File data (G-code, STL, 3MF). Used if "File URL" is empty. AP materializes the whole file into RAM before this action runs — for very large files prefer the File URL input below.

fileUrl.description: Alternative to File — an HTTPS URL the piece will stream directly to SimplyPrint without buffering the whole file in memory. Recommended for files over ~500 MB. The URL must return a Content-Length header (S3 pre-signed URLs, Dropbox raw links, etc.). If set, the File input is ignored.

filename.description: Name to store the file under on SimplyPrint. MUST include the correct extension (e.g. .gcode, .stl, .3mf) — the backend picks the file type from the extension, not the contents. Required when using File URL unless the URL path ends in a filename with an extension. Optional with File (defaults to source filename).

folderId.description: Numeric ID of the destination folder. Use 0 (or leave empty) to save to the root of the user file system. Look up folder IDs with the "List Files" action.

customFields.description: Optional. Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. PRINT category / USER_FILE sub-category is auto-applied.

aiMetadata.description: Upload a print file (File input or HTTPS URL) and save it as a persistent user-file inside a chosen folder of the SimplyPrint file system, returning a user-file UID. Pick this over plain upload-file when the file should live in the library/folders; pick upload-and-queue instead when the goal is to print it. Not idempotent — each call creates a new user-file.

move_file.name: move_file
move_file.description: Move one or more user files to a different folder.

fileUids.description: User-file UID string. Comma-separate to move several files at once. Use "List Files" to look up UIDs.

targetFolderId.description: Destination folder. Use 0 for the root folder.

aiMetadata.description: Moves one or more user files into a target folder, identified by user-file UID(s) (comma-separate to move several at once) and a destination folder ID (0 for root). Look up UIDs via "List Files". Idempotent: moving files already in the target folder leaves them in the same place.

create_folder.name: create_folder
create_folder.description: Create a new folder in the user file system, or update an existing one (pass the folder ID to edit). Optionally an "organization" / shared folder with per-rank view/upload/modify permissions.

folderId.description: Numeric ID of the folder to edit. Omit to create a new folder.

parentFolder.description: Numeric ID of the parent folder. Use 0 for root.

org.description: When true, the folder is shared across the company per the rank-based permissions below. Requires the Shared Folders feature.

viewRanks.description: Only used when "Shared folder" is true. Numeric user rank IDs allowed to view the folder.

uploadRanks.description: Only used when "Shared folder" is true. Numeric user rank IDs allowed to upload to the folder.

modifyRanks.description: Only used when "Shared folder" is true. Numeric user rank IDs allowed to modify / delete contents.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a folder in the user file system, or edits an existing one when a folder ID is supplied (the mode is chosen by whether that ID is present). Can mark it a shared "organization" folder with per-rank view/upload/modify permissions (requires the Shared Folders feature). Requires a name and parent folder ID (0 for root). Not idempotent in create mode: each call without a folder ID makes a new folder; edit mode keyed on a folder ID is idempotent.

delete_files.name: delete_files
delete_files.description: Permanently delete one or more user files by UID. Returns a partial-success report — files the caller can't modify are reported in `errors` while accessible files are deleted.

fileUids.description: UID strings of the files to delete. Look up via "List Files".

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete one or more SimplyPrint files by their UID, identifying them via the file UID strings (look these up with List Files first). Use when the caller wants to remove files from the account; deletion is destructive and not idempotent — re-running with an already-deleted UID surfaces that UID under the partial-success error report rather than succeeding.

delete_folders.name: delete_folders
delete_folders.description: Delete one or more folders (and everything in them). All-or-nothing: if any folder isn't modifiable by the caller, the whole call fails.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes one or more user-file folders and all of their contents, given numeric folder IDs. The call is all-or-nothing: it fails entirely if any listed folder is not modifiable by the caller. Idempotent in effect: re-deleting an already-gone folder converges to the same end state, but verify IDs first since this destroys files.

update_file.name: update_file
update_file.description: Rename a user file and / or update its compatible-printer assignments. (Thumbnail upload is not exposed here — multipart isn't supported on this endpoint over OAuth via the AP HTTP client.)

fileUid.description: UID string of the file to update (10-36 chars). Look up via "List Files".

name.description: New display name (max 256 chars). Keep the existing extension — backend infers file type from it.

printerIds.description: Numeric printer IDs the file is allowed to print on. Leave empty to clear printer-restriction.

printerModelIds.description: Numeric model IDs the file is allowed to print on. Leave empty to clear model-restriction.

removeThumbnail.description: When true, deletes any thumbnail currently stored on the file.

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing user file (identified by its UID): rename it and/or set which printers or printer models it is allowed to print on, and optionally remove its stored thumbnail. Pick this to edit file metadata in place; passing empty printer/model arrays clears those restrictions. It sets fields to the supplied values (upsert-by-UID), so repeating the same update is idempotent; at least one field must be provided.

download_file.name: download_file
download_file.description: Download a file from SimplyPrint by user-file UID, queue-item ID, or print-job UID. Returns the file as an Activepieces file reference plus content-type / size metadata.

source.description: Which kind of file to fetch.

identifier.description: UID for "User file" / "Print job", numeric ID for "Queue item". Look these up via "List Files" / "List Print History" / "List Queue Items".

filename.description: Name to store the downloaded file under in AP. Defaults to the Content-Disposition value or the identifier.

aiMetadata.description: Downloads a file from SimplyPrint and returns it as a reusable file reference for downstream steps. A "source" mode selects which kind of file the identifier refers to: user-file UID, numeric queue-item ID, or print-job UID. Use after locating the item via "List Files" / "List Queue Items" / "List Print History"; the identifier format must match the chosen source. Read-only and idempotent.

list_filaments.name: list_filaments
list_filaments.description: List filament spools in your SimplyPrint account, with optional filters and sort.

materialType.description: Substring match against material type, e.g. `PLA`, `PETG`. Leave empty for no filter.

brand.description: Substring match against brand name. Leave empty for no filter.

color.description: Substring match against color name, hex, or group. Leave empty for no filter.

assigned.description: Whether to include only assigned spools, only unassigned, or both.

empty.description: Filter by empty / non-empty status. "Empty" means filament left ≤ 0 or marked as emptied.

printerId.description: Only return spools currently assigned to this printer (numeric ID).

sortBy.description: Field to sort the result list by. Leave empty to use backend default ordering.

sortDir.description: Only applied when "Sort by" is set.

limit.description: Cap on returned spools (1–100). Leave empty for no cap. Backend has no offset-pagination on this endpoint, so this is the only cap available.

aiMetadata.description: Lists filament spools in the account, with optional filters (material type, brand, color, assigned/unassigned, empty/non-empty, assigned printer) and sort. Use to find spools or check stock before assigning filament or starting a print; leave all filters empty to return every spool. This endpoint has no offset paging, so "limit" (1-100) is the only cap. Read-only and idempotent.

get_filament.name: get_filament
get_filament.description: Get detailed information about a specific filament spool by numeric ID or 4-character short ID (uid).

filamentId.description: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag. In automation flows this typically comes from a previous step (trigger payload, MCP response, etc.).

aiMetadata.description: Read-only lookup of a single filament spool's full details by numeric spool ID or 4-char short ID (uid). Pick this when you already have one spool reference and need its current attributes (material, color, remaining amount, etc.); to enumerate spools instead, use the list action.

create_filament.name: create_filament
create_filament.description: Add a new filament spool to your inventory. Use the free-text brand/color fields for ad-hoc spools or the catalog ids for known SKUs.

brand.description: Free-text brand name (always required, even when catalog ids are set).

colorHex.description: Hex color (e.g. `#FF8800`). For multi-color spools, comma-separate (e.g. `#FF8800,#0044CC`).

totalLength.description: Spool size — interpretation depends on "Length type" below. Required when creating a new spool.

totalLengthType.description: Unit for "Total length / weight" and "Length used".

lengthRemaining.description: Amount of filament still on the spool. For a brand-new untouched spool, set this equal to "Total length / weight". For a partially-used spool, set this lower. Same unit as "Length type". (Backend's `length_used` POST param is, despite its name, semantically "remaining" — see Create.php math.)

amount.description: Create N identical spools at once (capped at 500). Defaults to 1.

filamentType.description: Numeric id of the material type / profile (look up via "List Filaments" results — `type.id` on each spool — or via your filament management page). EITHER this OR a "Catalog filament ID" (+ optional "Catalog variant ID") pair is required when creating a new spool — the backend uses the catalog chain to auto-resolve / auto-import a profile. Throws "The Filament type is required" if neither is set.

cost.description: Optional. Spool cost in account currency (cents/whole-units depending on your currency).

locationId.description: Optional. Numeric id of the storage location.

nfcId.description: Optional. NFC tag identifier for app tracking.

qrId.description: Optional. 4-character short id printed on the spool QR sticker. Auto-generated if omitted.

aiMetadata.description: Create one or more new filament spool records in inventory, supplying brand/color/diameter and total length-or-weight, optionally via catalog SKU IDs instead of free-text. Use the "Number of spools" field to create N identical spools at once (capped at 500). Not idempotent — each call adds new spools, so re-running creates duplicates; either a material type ID or a catalog filament-ID chain is required.

adjust_filament_weight.name: adjust_filament_weight
adjust_filament_weight.description: Update the remaining filament on a spool. Provide ONE of "grams remaining" / "percent remaining" / "weighed gross" — the other two derive from it.

filamentId.description: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.

gramsRemaining.description: Net grams of filament left on the spool.

percentRemaining.description: Alternative to grams — share of the spool still on the reel.

weighedGross.description: Total weight including the empty spool. Combine with "subtract empty spool" to compute net.

emptySpoolWeight.description: Override the empty spool weight used for the gross calculation.

saveEmptySpoolWeight.displayName: Persist empty spool weight on spool record

aiMetadata.description: Set the remaining filament on a spool, identified by numeric ID or the 4-character QR/NFC short ID, by supplying exactly one of grams remaining, percent remaining, or weighed gross (with optional empty-spool-weight handling). Pick it to correct or record spool inventory. Idempotent: the call sets the spool to an absolute value rather than incrementing.

mark_filament_dried.name: mark_filament_dried
mark_filament_dried.description: Record that one or more spools were just dried. Updates each spool's last-dried timestamp.

filamentIds.description: Spool IDs (numeric) or 4-character short IDs (uid) — comma-separated short IDs are resolved one-by-one. Pure numeric values skip the lookup round-trip.

driedAt.description: When drying completed. Defaults to now if omitted (e.g. `2026-04-26T12:34:00Z`).

aiMetadata.description: Record a drying event for one or more spools (by numeric ID or 4-char short ID), setting each spool's last-dried timestamp to the given time or now. Pick this after running spools through a dryer to keep moisture tracking current; it overwrites the last-dried timestamp, so re-running it advances the recorded time rather than stacking.

get_filament_history.name: get_filament_history
get_filament_history.description: Paginated usage history for a specific spool — print jobs, weight adjustments, drying cycles, etc.

filamentId.description: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.

perPage.description: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to backend default.

aiMetadata.description: Read-only, paginated history of events for a single filament spool (by numeric ID or 4-char short ID) — print jobs, weight adjustments, drying cycles, and similar. Pick this to audit how a specific spool has been used over time; use Get Filament for the spool's current state rather than its event log.

assign_filament.name: assign_filament
assign_filament.description: Assign a filament spool to a printer at a specific nozzle + extruder slot. Defaults to nozzle 0 / extruder 0 (single-nozzle single-extruder printers); set the indices for multi-nozzle (e.g. IDEX, toolchanger) or multi-material (MMS, MMU) printers.

printerId.description: Numeric printer ID. In automation flows this typically flows in from a trigger or upstream step.

filamentId.description: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.

nozzleIndex.description: Which nozzle on the printer (0-based). Use 0 for single-nozzle printers. Multi-nozzle printers (IDEX, toolchanger) use 1+ for the additional nozzles. Backend rejects with "Nozzle out of range" if the printer doesn't have this many nozzles.

extruderIndex.description: Which extruder on the chosen nozzle (0-based). Use 0 for single-extruder nozzles. Multi-material setups (MMS, MMU, AMS) use 1+ for the additional extruders feeding the same nozzle. Backend rejects with "Extruder out of range" if the nozzle doesn't have this many extruders.

aiMetadata.description: Load a filament spool (by numeric ID or 4-char short ID) onto a printer at a given nozzle/extruder slot, defaulting to nozzle 0 / extruder 0. Pick this to record which spool is mounted before a print; set the nozzle/extruder indices for multi-nozzle or multi-material printers. Assigning the same spool to the same slot again is effectively idempotent (it sets the slot to that spool); the backend rejects out-of-range nozzle/extruder indices.

unassign_filament.name: unassign_filament
unassign_filament.description: Detach a specific filament spool from whichever printer it is currently assigned to.

filamentId.description: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.

aiMetadata.description: Detach a filament spool (by numeric ID or 4-char short ID) from whatever printer/slot it is currently mounted on; the backend infers the printer from the spool's current assignment, so you only supply the spool. Pick this to free a spool before moving or replacing it; unassigning an already-unassigned spool has no further effect, so the result state is idempotent.

list_print_history.name: list_print_history
list_print_history.description: List completed print jobs, optionally filtered to a single printer.

printerId.description: Restrict to jobs from a specific printer. Leave empty for all printers.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per page (default 25, max 100).

aiMetadata.description: Lists completed print jobs page by page, optionally restricted to a single printer ID. Use to browse or search print history and obtain job UIDs before calling "Get Print Job" or "Download File"; leave the printer filter empty to span all printers. Supports page/limit paging (default 25, max 100 per page). Read-only and idempotent.

get_print_job.name: get_print_job
get_print_job.description: Fetch a single print job's full record by its UID — timeline, pictures, spools used, gcode analysis, filament data, cost, AI inference, custom fields, etc.

jobUid.description: Print job UID string (typically 10+ characters). Comes from "List Print History" results or webhook payloads.

includeCustomFieldDefinitions.description: When true, also returns the schema for the custom fields attached to the job (vs just values).

aiMetadata.description: Fetches one completed print job's full detail record by its print-job UID. Use to drill into a specific job after finding it via "List Print History" or a webhook; an optional flag also returns the custom-field schema alongside values. Requires the UID string (not a numeric ID). Read-only and idempotent.

archive_print_jobs.name: archive_print_jobs
archive_print_jobs.description: Archive one or more completed print jobs (removes them from the active history view).

reason.description: Optional note explaining why the jobs were archived (max 500 chars).

aiMetadata.description: Archive one or more completed print jobs by ID, removing them from the active history view, with an optional reason note. Use this to clean up finished jobs from the working history; archiving an already-archived job has no further effect, so the state change is idempotent per job.

unarchive_print_jobs.name: unarchive_print_jobs
unarchive_print_jobs.description: Restore one or more archived print jobs to the active history view.

aiMetadata.description: Restore previously archived print jobs back into the active print-history view, given their numeric job IDs. Pick it to reverse an archive action; the inverse archive operation is a separate tool. Re-running with the same IDs is safe (already-active jobs stay active), so the effect is idempotent.

list_tags.name: list_tags
list_tags.description: List all custom tags configured on your account.

aiMetadata.description: Lists every custom tag configured on the account. Use to discover tag IDs/names before filtering or attaching tags, or to delete one via "Delete Tag". Takes no input; returns an empty list when the account has no custom tags. Read-only and idempotent.

create_tag.name: create_tag
create_tag.description: Create a new custom tag, or rename / re-style an existing one (pass the tag ID to edit).

tagId.description: Numeric tag ID to edit. Omit to create a new tag.

badge.description: Bootstrap badge color used to render the tag.

aiMetadata.description: Create a custom tag with a name and badge color, or edit an existing one by passing its tag ID. Pick it to manage the tag catalog itself, not to attach/remove tags from entities (use the attach/detach tools for that). Create mode is not idempotent (a repeat call makes another tag); edit mode by stable ID is idempotent.

assign_tag.name: assign_tag
assign_tag.description: Attach an existing custom tag to a printer, printer group, file, or queue item. Use "Create or Update Tag" first to get the tag ID.

subjectType.description: What kind of entity to tag.

subjectIds.description: Numeric IDs (or UID strings for files) of the entities to tag. Provide one or many.

tagIds.description: Numeric custom tag IDs to attach. From "List Tags" or "Create or Update Tag".

override.description: When true, replaces the subject's current custom tags. When false (default), merges with existing tags.

aiMetadata.description: Attach one or more existing custom tags (by tag ID) to printers, printer groups, files, or queue items, selected via the subject type. By default it merges the tags into the subject's current set, so re-applying the same tags is harmless; enable "Replace existing tags" to overwrite the subject's tags instead, which is a destructive mode. The tags must already exist (create them first); this does not auto-create tags.

detach_tag.name: detach_tag
detach_tag.description: Remove a single custom tag from one printer, printer group, file, or queue item.

subjectId.description: Numeric ID (or UID string for files) of the entity to detach the tag from.

tagId.description: Numeric custom tag ID to remove.

aiMetadata.description: Detach one custom tag (by tag ID) from a single entity — choose the subject type (printer, printer group, file, or queue item) and give its ID. Pick it to untag an entity, not to delete the tag definition itself. Idempotent: detaching a tag not present is a no-op.

delete_tag.name: delete_tag
delete_tag.description: Delete a custom tag from the account. The tag is removed from every printer/file/queue item it was attached to.

tagId.description: Numeric custom tag ID to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Deletes a custom tag from the account by its numeric tag ID, detaching it from every printer, file, and queue item it was attached to. Look up the ID via "List Tags" first. Idempotent in effect: the end state is the same whether or not the tag still existed.

get_current_user.name: get_current_user
get_current_user.description: Return information about the SimplyPrint account connected to this flow.

aiMetadata.description: Look up the SimplyPrint account, company, and user identity behind the current connection. Read-only; pick it to resolve who the flow is acting as or to discover the account/company ID needed by other steps. Takes no inputs.

list_custom_fields.name: list_custom_fields
list_custom_fields.description: List all custom field definitions on your account.

entity.description: Optional — e.g. PRINT_QUEUE, FILE, USER. Leave empty to list all.

page.description: Specific page number (1-based). Leave empty to walk all pages and return every field.

pageSize.description: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 100 when paging is requested.

aiMetadata.description: List the custom-field definitions on the account, optionally filtered by entity (e.g. PRINT_QUEUE, FILE, USER). Read-only; pick it to discover field UUIDs before submitting custom-field values on queue/upload actions. By default walks every page; pass an explicit page for single-page mode. Idempotent.

set_custom_field_values.name: set_custom_field_values
set_custom_field_values.description: Set custom field values on one or more entities (queue items, files, printers, etc.).

category.description: Entity category the fields belong to.

subCategory.description: Only applicable for the "print" category. Pick the specific entity type the fields belong to.

entityIds.description: Numeric IDs of the target entities.

values.description: Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. Converted to the backend submission array automatically.

aiMetadata.description: Writes custom-field values onto one or more entities selected by a category (print, printer, filament, user file, user) and, for the "print" category, a sub-category that pins the exact entity type. Values are an object keyed by custom-field UUID. Use to populate or overwrite metadata on known entity IDs; idempotent because it sets each field to the supplied value rather than appending.

get_statistics.name: get_statistics
get_statistics.description: Fetch high-level printing statistics (total prints, materials used, hours, etc.).

aiMetadata.description: Read-only fetch of lifetime account-level printing statistics (total prints, materials used, total hours, etc.) in the panel's general/overview mode. Pick this for a high-level summary of account usage; it takes no inputs and never modifies anything.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Call any SimplyPrint REST endpoint the piece does not wrap directly. Useful for admin / partner / school-dashboard endpoints and anything else behind OAuth scopes.

path.description: Endpoint path relative to the account, e.g. "printers/Get" or "queue/AddItem". Do not include the host or the account ID segment.

includeResponseHeaders.description: Return `{ body, headers, status }` instead of just the body.

aiMetadata.description: Makes an arbitrary authenticated HTTP request to any SimplyPrint REST endpoint, choosing the method, path, query params, and JSON body. Use as an escape hatch for endpoints this piece does not wrap with a dedicated action. Not idempotent — the effect depends on the method and endpoint called.

print_started.name: print_started
print_started.description: Fires when a print job starts on any printer.

print_paused.name: print_paused
print_paused.description: Fires when a print is paused (manually or by the AI failure watcher).

print_resumed.name: print_resumed
print_resumed.description: Fires when a paused print is resumed.

print_cancelled.name: print_cancelled
print_cancelled.description: Fires when a print is cancelled before finishing.

print_finished.name: print_finished
print_finished.description: Fires when a print completes successfully.

print_failed.name: print_failed
print_failed.description: Fires when a print terminates with a failure.

bed_cleared.name: bed_cleared
bed_cleared.description: Fires when a printer's bed is reported cleared (ready for the next job).

objects_skipped.name: objects_skipped
objects_skipped.description: Fires when one or more objects in a multi-object print are skipped.

printer_autoprint_state_changed.name: printer_autoprint_state_changed
printer_autoprint_state_changed.description: Fires when a printer's AutoPrint enabled/disabled state changes.

printer_nozzle_size_changed.name: printer_nozzle_size_changed
printer_nozzle_size_changed.description: Fires when a printer's active nozzle diameter is updated.

printer_material_changed.name: printer_material_changed
printer_material_changed.description: Fires when a printer's loaded material is updated.

printer_tag_assigned.name: printer_tag_assigned
printer_tag_assigned.description: Fires when a custom tag is attached to a printer.

printer_tag_detached.name: printer_tag_detached
printer_tag_detached.description: Fires when a custom tag is detached from a printer.

printer_out_of_order_state_changed.name: printer_out_of_order_state_changed
printer_out_of_order_state_changed.description: Fires when a printer is marked out of order (or back in service).

ai_state_changed.name: ai_state_changed
ai_state_changed.description: Fires when a printer's AI failure detection is enabled, disabled, or reconfigured.

ai_failure_detected.name: ai_failure_detected
ai_failure_detected.description: Fires when the AI failure detector flags a potential print failure.

ai_failure_false_positive.name: ai_failure_false_positive
ai_failure_false_positive.description: Fires when an AI failure alert is dismissed as a false positive.

printer_autoprint_max_cycles.name: printer_autoprint_max_cycles
printer_autoprint_max_cycles.description: Fires when a printer hits its configured AutoPrint cycle limit.

company_autoprint_state_changed.name: company_autoprint_state_changed
company_autoprint_state_changed.description: Fires when the account-wide AutoPrint master switch is toggled.

queue_item_added.name: queue_item_added
queue_item_added.description: Fires when a file is added to the print queue.

queue_item_deleted.name: queue_item_deleted
queue_item_deleted.description: Fires when a queue item is removed from the queue.

queue_emptied.name: queue_emptied
queue_emptied.description: Fires when a queue group (or the whole queue) is emptied.

queue_item_moved.name: queue_item_moved
queue_item_moved.description: Fires when a queue item is moved to another group or reordered.

queue_item_revived.name: queue_item_revived
queue_item_revived.description: Fires when a completed queue item is sent back into the active queue.

queue_item_pending_approval.name: queue_item_pending_approval
queue_item_pending_approval.description: Fires when a queue item is submitted and awaits approval.

queue_item_approved.name: queue_item_approved
queue_item_approved.description: Fires when a pending queue item is approved.

queue_item_denied.name: queue_item_denied
queue_item_denied.description: Fires when a pending queue item is denied.

filament_created.name: filament_created
filament_created.description: Fires when a filament spool is added to the account.

filament_updated.name: filament_updated
filament_updated.description: Fires when a filament spool's metadata is updated.

filament_deleted.name: filament_deleted
filament_deleted.description: Fires when a filament spool is deleted.

filament_assigned.name: filament_assigned
filament_assigned.description: Fires when a filament spool is assigned to a printer.

filament_unassigned.name: filament_unassigned
filament_unassigned.description: Fires when a filament spool is removed from a printer.

organization_user_signup.name: organization_user_signup
organization_user_signup.description: Fires when a new user signs up for the organization.

organization_user_pending.name: organization_user_pending
organization_user_pending.description: Fires when a new organization user is awaiting admin approval.

balance_charged.name: balance_charged
balance_charged.description: Fires when a user balance is charged (debited).

balance_refunded.name: balance_refunded
balance_refunded.description: Fires when a previous charge is refunded.

balance_topped_up.name: balance_topped_up
balance_topped_up.description: Fires when a user balance is topped up (credited).

balance_adjusted.name: balance_adjusted
balance_adjusted.description: Fires when a balance is adjusted by an administrator.

quota_request_new.name: quota_request_new
quota_request_new.description: Fires when a user submits a request for more quota.

quota_request_resolved.name: quota_request_resolved
quota_request_resolved.description: Fires when a quota request is approved or denied.

quota_adjusted.name: quota_adjusted
quota_adjusted.description: Fires when a user's quota is manually adjusted.

quota_reset.name: quota_reset
quota_reset.description: Fires when a quota period rolls over and a user's quota is reset.

maintenance_job_created.name: maintenance_job_created
maintenance_job_created.description: Fires when a maintenance job is created.

maintenance_job_started.name: maintenance_job_started
maintenance_job_started.description: Fires when work begins on a maintenance job.

maintenance_job_completed.name: maintenance_job_completed
maintenance_job_completed.description: Fires when a maintenance job is completed.

maintenance_job_cancelled.name: maintenance_job_cancelled
maintenance_job_cancelled.description: Fires when a maintenance job is cancelled before completion.

maintenance_job_overdue.name: maintenance_job_overdue
maintenance_job_overdue.description: Fires when a scheduled maintenance job passes its due date without being completed.

maintenance_job_reopened.name: maintenance_job_reopened
maintenance_job_reopened.description: Fires when a completed or cancelled maintenance job is reopened.

maintenance_job_updated.name: maintenance_job_updated
maintenance_job_updated.description: Fires when a maintenance job's metadata is edited.

maintenance_job_deleted.description: Fires when a maintenance job is deleted.

nl.3D printer fleet management: monitor pri: 3D printer vlootmanagement: monitor printers, beheer de print wachtrij, track filament en automatiseer print jobs.
nl.\nClick **Connect** below to authorize A: Klik hieronder op **Verbinden** om Activepieces te autoriseren voor toegang tot uw SimplyPrint account. De verbinding vernieuwt automatisch opnieuw. Trek op elk moment uit **SimplyPrint → Paneel → Instellingen → Gekoppelde apps**.
nl.Preview Next Queue Items per Printer: Voorbeeld van Volgende Wachtrij Items per Printer
nl.Set Queue Item Printer Assignments: Stel Printer opdracht in de wachtrij
nl.Upload File & Add to Queue: Upload bestand & voeg toe aan wachtrij
nl.List every printer in your SimplyPrint a: Toon elke printer in uw SimplyPrint account met de huidige status.
nl.One-shot fleet summary: total printer co: One-shot vloot samenvatting: totaal aantal printer plus per-bucket lijsten (online/offline, drukken/gepauzeerd, in afwachting van bed clear in onderhoud, vereiste aandacht, AI-foutdetecties, …). Gebruik dit in plaats van het pagineren van "Lijst Printers" wanneer je alleen telt en de printers nodig hebt in elke staat.
nl.Get detailed information about a specifi: Krijg gedetailleerde informatie over een specifieke printer.
Pauzeer de huidige afdruk op een printer.
Hervat een gepauzeerd drukwerk op een printer.
nl.Cancel the current print on a printer. T: Annuleer de huidige afdruk op een printer. Dit is destructief - de taak kan niet worden hervat.
nl.Cancel a print that's queued/staged on a: Annuleer een bedrukking die in de wachtrij staat op een printer maar nog niet gestart is (status = print_pending). Verschillende print afbreken van "Annuleren Print", dat op de actieve afdruk is gericht.
nl.Mark a printer's bed as cleared after a: Markeer het bed van een printer als gewist na het afwerken van een opdruk. De stap Bread-and-boter in AutoPrint flows — koppel met een "print done" trigger om bed clearing te automatiseren.
nl.Skip one or more individual model object: Sla een of meer individuele modelobjecten op het huidige afdruk over (printer moet in PRINTING / PAUSED / PAUSTEN / ANCELLING / RESUMING status zijn). Enkele printer per oproep.
nl.Mark one or more printers as out-of-orde: Markeer een of meer printers als uit de order (of wis deze vlag). Vereist de out/orderfunctie op het account.
nl.Send raw G-code commands to an operation: Stuur rauwe G-code commando's naar een operationele printer (vereist Print Boerderij plan).
nl.Start a print job on one or more printer: Start een afdruktaak bij één of meer printers van een bestaand bestand, wachtrij item, of print-job referentie.
nl.Fetch the open notifications/events on o: Haal de open meldingen/evenementen op op een of meerdere printers. Pairs goed met de `requires_attention` emmer van "Pak Boerderij Overzicht".
nl.Mark a printer notification as resolved: Markeer een printer notificatie als afgehandeld (of verwijderd). Voor meldingen met meerdere acties, geef `action` aan om er een of `force: true` te kiezen zonder te kiezen.
nl.List items in the print queue, optionall: Items weergeven in de printwachtrij, optioneel gefilterd tot een enkele wachtrij groep.
nl.Fetch a single queue item by numeric ID: Ophalen van een enkel wachtrijitem op numerieke ID — retourneert het geformatteerde record (bestand metadata, toewijzingen, aangepaste velden, …).
nl.Resolve the next-up queue items for one: Los de volgende wachtrij items op voor één of meer printers met behulp van de overeenkomstcriteria van het bedrijf (met deduplicatie, zodat hetzelfde item nooit tweemaal is toegewezen). Geeft als resultaat het overeenkomende wachtrij object met item referenties per printer.
nl.Read-only preview of the next-up queue i: Alleen-lezen voorbeeld van het volgende wachtrij item voor elk gegeven printer (geen dedup, geen offline controles). Geef voor elke printer het gematchde wachtrij item of de problemen die een match blokkeren. Anders dan "Get Next Queue Items": dat één dedupes voor een werkelijke planning, laat deze zien wat elke printer zou zien.
Toon elke wachtrijgroep op uw account.
nl.Create or update a queue group. Pass an: Een wachtrij groep aanmaken of bijwerken. Geef een bestaand groep-ID door om het te bewerken; laat het over om een nieuwe te maken. Vereist de functie Wachtrij Groepen op de account.
nl.Delete a queue group. Items in the group: Verwijder een wachtrij groep. Items in de groep zijn verplaatst naar de "Verplaats naar" groep. of op de eerste resterende groep als het niet is opgegeven, of als het niet is ingesteld op ungrouped als het de laatste groep was.
nl.Add an existing file (API-uploaded or us: Voeg een bestaand bestand (API-geüpload of gebruikersbestand) toe aan de afspeellijst. Voor het tegelijkertijd uploaden van een nieuw bestand, gebruik "Bestand uploaden & Toevoegen aan wachtrij".
nl.Update a queue item (amount, note, etc.): Update een wachtrij item (bedrag, notitie, etc.).
nl.Assign one or more queue items to specif: Wijs een of meer wachtrijitems toe aan specifieke printers, printer modellen en/of printergroepen. Vervangt de huidige opdrachten van elk item.
nl.Move a queue item to a different queue g: Verplaats een wachtrij item naar een andere wachtrij groep.
nl.Remove an item from the print queue. Des: Verwijder een item uit de printwachtrij. Verwoestructive - het item is verdwenen.
nl.Bring a completed (done) queue item back: Breng een voltooid (done) wachtrijitem terug naar de actieve wachtrij.
nl.Delete every item from the print queue (: Verwijder elk item uit de printwachtrij (optioneel gefilterd naar een groep of alleen doner). Vernietig.
nl.List queue items awaiting approval, deni: Lijst van wachtrij items wachtend op goedkeuring, geweigerd of verzonden voor herziening.
Goedkeuren van een of meerdere wachtrij-items.
nl.Deny a pending queue item (remove or sen: Weiger een wachtrijitem (verwijder of verzend terug voor herziening).
nl.List files in your SimplyPrint account,: Laat bestanden zien in uw SimplyPrint account, eventueel binnen een map en/of gefilterd door een zoekterm.
nl.Upload a file or HTTPS URL to SimplyPrin: Upload een bestand of HTTPS URL naar SimplyPrint. URL uploads stream met ~95 MiB peak RAM; Bestandsuploads worden gebufferd door AP. Bestanden boven 95 MiB worden automatisch gehakt. Geeft het API-bestands-id door - geef het door aan "Bestand toevoegen aan wachtrij" of "Print" later.
nl.Upload a local file or HTTPS URL to Simp: Upload een lokaal bestand of HTTPS URL naar SimplyPrint en voeg het in één stap toe aan de afdruk. URL uploads stream met ~95 MiB peak RAM; Bestandsuploads zijn gebufferd door AP. Bestanden boven 95 MiB worden automatisch gehakt. Om het afdrukken nadien te starten zet u een "Start Print" actie in.
nl.Upload a file (or HTTPS URL) and save it: Upload een bestand (of HTTPS URL) en sla het op in uw SimplyPrint gebruikersbestandssysteem, eventueel binnen een specifieke map. URL uploads stream met ~95 MiB peak RAM; Bestandsuploads worden gebufferd door AP. Bestanden boven 95 MiB worden automatisch gehakt.
nl.Move one or more user files to a differe: Verplaats een of meer gebruikersbestanden naar een andere map.
nl.Create a new folder in the user file sys: Maak een nieuwe map aan in het gebruikersbestandssysteem of werk een bestaande bij (geef de map-ID door om te bewerken). Optioneel een "organisatie" / gedeelde map met per-rank weergave/upload/wijziging rechten.
nl.Permanently delete one or more user file: Permanent één of meer gebruikersbestanden van UID verwijderen. Geeft een gedeeltelijk rapport terug - bestanden die de beller niet kan wijzigen worden gerapporteerd in `errors` wanneer toegankelijke bestanden worden verwijderd.
nl.Delete one or more folders (and everythi: Verwijder één of meer mappen (en alles in deze). Alleen-of-niets: als een map niet kan worden gewijzigd door de beller kan het hele gesprek mislukken.
nl.Rename a user file and / or update its c: Hernoem een gebruikersbestand en / of werk de compatibele printer toewijzingen bij. (Thumbnail upload is hier niet blootgelegd — op dit eindpunt boven OAuth wordt geen multipart ondersteund via de HTTP-cliënt.)
nl.Download a file from SimplyPrint by user: Download een bestand van SimplyPrint door gebruikersbestand UID, wachtrij-item ID, of afdrukwerk UID. Retourneert het bestand als een Activepieces bestand plus content-type / size metadata.
nl.List filament spools in your SimplyPrint: Laat filterspools zien in jouw SimplyPrint account, met optionele filters en sorteren.
nl.Get detailed information about a specifi: Krijg gedetailleerde informatie over een specifieke filmspool met numerieke ID of 4-karakter kort ID (uid).
nl.Add a new filament spool to your invento: Voeg een nieuwe filmspool toe aan je inventaris. Gebruik de velden voor vrije tekst of kleur voor ad-hoc-spools of de catalogus id's voor bekende SKU's.
nl.Update the remaining filament on a spool: Update de rest van de film op een spool. Geef EEN "Resterende grammen" / "resterende percentage" / "gewogen bruto" - de andere twee ontlenen eraan.
nl.Record that one or more spools were just: Neem op dat één of meer spools net zijn gedroogd. Werkt elke spool's laatste tijdsaanduiding bij.
nl.Paginated usage history for a specific s: Geïntegreerde gebruiksgeschiedenis voor specifieke spool - drukwerk, gewichtsaanpassingen, droogcycli, etc.
nl.Assign a filament spool to a printer at: Wijs een filterspool toe aan een printer op een specifiek nozzle + extruder slot. Standaard ingesteld op nozzle 0 / extruder 0 (single-nozzle extruder printers); stel de indexen in voor multi-nozzle (bijv. IDEX, toolchanger) of meerdere materialen (MMS, MMU) printers.
nl.Detach a specific filament spool from wh: Ontkoppel een specifieke filament spool van de printer waaraan het momenteel is toegewezen.
nl.List completed print jobs, optionally fi: Toon voltooide afdrukbanen, eventueel gefilterd naar een enkele printer.
nl.Fetch a single print job's full record b: Haal één print job volledig op door haar UID - tijdlijn, foto's, spools gebruikt, gcode analyse, filament gegevens, kosten, AI gevolg, aangepaste velden, enz.
nl.Archive one or more completed print jobs: Archiveer een of meer voltooide print taken (verwijdert ze van de actieve historie).
nl.Restore one or more archived print jobs: Herstel een of meer gearchiveerde afdruktaken naar de actieve geschiedenisweergave.
nl.List all custom tags configured on your: Laat alle aangepaste tags zien die zijn geconfigureerd op uw account.
nl.Create a new custom tag, or rename / re-: Maak een nieuwe aangepaste tag aan of hernoem / herstijl een bestaande (geef de tag ID door om te bewerken).
nl.Attach an existing custom tag to a print: Voeg een bestaande aangepaste tag toe aan een printer, printer groep, bestand of wachtrij. Gebruik eerst "Maak of Update Tag" om de tag ID te krijgen.
nl.Remove a single custom tag from one prin: Verwijder een enkele aangepaste tag van een printer, printer groep, bestand of wachtrij item.
nl.Delete a custom tag from the account. Th: Verwijder een aangepaste tag van het account. De tag wordt verwijderd van elk printer/file/queue item waaraan het was gekoppeld.
nl.Return information about the SimplyPrint: Retourneer informatie over het SimplyPrint account gekoppeld aan dit stroom.
nl.List all custom field definitions on you: Toon alle aangepaste velddefinities op uw account.
nl.Set custom field values on one or more e: Stel aangepaste veldwaarden in op één of meer entiteiten (wachtrij items, bestanden, printers, enz.).
nl.Fetch high-level printing statistics (to: Hoog hoge drukkerijstatistieken op (totale afdruk, gebruikte materialen, uren, etc.).
nl.Call any SimplyPrint REST endpoint the p: Noem Eenvoudig afdrukken van REST eindpunt dat het stuk niet direct omslaat. Handig voor admin / partner / school-dashboard eindpunten en iets anders achter OAuth scopes.
nl.Restrict to printer model IDs: Beperken tot model IDs van printer
nl.Subtract empty spool from gross: Trek lege spool af van bruto
nl.Persist empty spool weight on spool reco: Houd leeg spool gewicht aan op spool record
nl.Specific page number (1-based). Leave em: Specifieke paginanummer (1 op de basis). Laat leeg om alle pagina's te lopen en geef elke printer terug.
nl.Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 10: Items per pagina (max 100). Standaard is 100 bij paging aangevraagd.
nl.Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in f: Numerieke printer ID. Meestal doorgestuurd van een upstream stap.
nl.Numeric printer IDs whose pending prints: Numerieke printer IDs waarvan de in behandeling zijnde afdrukken moeten worden geannuleerd.
nl.Was the bed actually cleared (true) or d: Is het bed daadwerkelijk gewist (waar) of is het mislukt (onwaar)? Rijdt AutoPrint clear-count logica.
nl.Optional 1-4 star rating for the just-fi: Optionele 1-4 sterren waardering voor de slechts afgedrukte print.
nl.When checked, resets the AutoPrint clear: Wanneer aangevinkt, reset de AutoPrint verwijderdebed teller op de printer.
Numerieke printer ID van de actieve print.
nl.Numeric indices of the objects to skip (: Numerieke indices van de objecten die overgeslagen moeten worden (als blootgesteld door de slicer/printer's objectenlijst).
nl.True = mark as out-of-order. False = cle: True = marken als out-of-order. False = wis de vlag.
nl.One G-code command per line, e.g. \"G28\: Een G-code opdracht per regel, bijvoorbeeld "G28" dan "M104 S200". Maximaal 200 regels per verzoek.
nl.Pick one or more printers from your acco: Kies een of meer printers uit je account.
nl.Which kind of existing reference to star: Welk soort bestaande referentie om vanaf te beginnen?
nl.Required when source is \"API file\". He: Vereist wanneer bron "API bestand" is. Hex hash geretourneerd door Upload File.
nl.Required when source is \"User file\". T: Vereist wanneer de bron "Gebruikersbestand" is. De UserFile.uid string.
Vereist wanneer bron het item "Wachtrij" is.
nl.Custom-field values applied to every sta: Custom-field waarden toegepast op elke gestarte job (PRINT_JOB). Sleuteld door custom-field UUID (fieldId) → waarde.
nl.Optional. JSON array `[{\"id\": <queueIt: Optioneel. JSON array `[{"id": <queueItemId>, "waarde": {"<fieldId>": <value>}}]`. Per-item PRINT_JOB aangepaste velden bij het starten van een multi-queue taak.
nl.Optional slicer/print-time metadata (noz: Optionele slicer/afdruktijd metagegevens (nozzle, filament_materiaal, print_snelheid, layer_height, infille, kwaliteit). Willekeurige sleutels toegestaan.
nl.Optional. JSON object mapping printer id: Optioneel. JSON object mapping printer id → multimateriële slot configuratie. Laat leeg voor enkelvoudige materiaal printers.
nl.Numeric printer ID the notification belo: Numerieke printer ID waar de notificatie toe behoort.
nl.Numeric notification event ID. Use \"Get: Numeric notification event event ID. Gebruik "Get Printer Notifications" om het op te zoeken.
nl.For multi-action notifications, the acti: Voor multi-actie meldingen dient de actie toets aan te roepen. Laat leeg voor enkelvoudige actie of verwijder meldingen.
nl.Resolve immediately even if multiple act: Onmiddellijk oplossen, zelfs als er meerdere acties beschikbaar zijn (sla er één over).
Markeer als afgewezen in plaats van opgelost.
nl.Numeric queue group ID to filter by. Lea: Numerieke wachtrij groep ID waarop u wilt filteren. Laat leeg voor de hele wachtrij.
nl.Page number (1-based). Only applies to t: Paginanummer (1-gebaseerd). Alleen van toepassing op het actief-wachtrij pad; genegeerd wanneer "Inclusief voltooide items" ingeschakeld is.
nl.Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 10: Items per pagina (max 100). Standaard ingesteld op 100.
nl.Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped i: Numerieke wachtrij item ID. Meestal doorgestuurd van een upstream stap.
nl.Optional. Printer IDs to skip when match: Optioneel. Printer IDs om over te slaan bij het overeenstemmen (bv. printers momenteel bezig).
nl.Numeric ID of the group to edit. Omit to: Numeriek ID van de te wijzigen groep. Weglaten om een nieuwe groep aan te maken.
